SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"ssrf\":{\"allowlist\":[{\"type\":\"cidr\",\"value\":\"127.0.0.0/8\"}],\"deny_private\":true,\"max_redirects\":5},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.title)
```
